## Summary
Persist generated items to Supabase (first) and Neo4j (second) with full provenance metadata and 9 classification edges connecting each AssessmentItem to its three hubs and supporting nodes.

## User story
As a pipeline step, I need to persist generated items with full provenance and classification, so that items are queryable for faculty review and correctly positioned in the knowledge graph.

## Why this matters
This is the persistence boundary of the pipeline. If Supabase write fails, items are lost. If Neo4j edges are incomplete, items fail the three-hub invariant (D06) and are blocked from the practice pool. The 9 classification edges are what make items discoverable, filterable, and connected to the curriculum structure. Rule 6 (G08) is critical here: Supabase FIRST, Neo4j SECOND, Neo4j failure never blocks.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Write items to Supabase `assessment_items` table FIRST (Rule 6)
- [ ] Write Neo4j AssessmentItem nodes SECOND
- [ ] Neo4j failure does NOT block -- items saved in Supabase with `neo4j_sync_status: 'pending'`
- [ ] 9 classification edges created per item in Neo4j:
  1. AssessmentItem -[:TESTS]-> SubConcept (knowledge hub)
  2. AssessmentItem -[:ALIGNED_TO]-> SLO (pedagogical hub)
  3. AssessmentItem -[:MAPS_TO]-> USMLE_Subtopic (assessment hub)
  4. AssessmentItem -[:USES_SHELL]-> TaskShell
  5. AssessmentItem -[:TARGETS_BLOOM]-> BloomLevel
  6. AssessmentItem -[:TARGETS_DIFFICULTY]-> DifficultyBand
  7. AssessmentItem -[:SOURCED_FROM]-> ContentChunk (provenance)
  8. AssessmentItem -[:HAS_MISCONCEPTION]-> MisconceptionCategory (per distractor)
  9. AssessmentItem -[:GENERATED_BY]-> GenerationSpec
- [ ] Three-hub invariant validated: edges 1, 2, 3 all present before marking item `ready_for_review`
- [ ] Items missing any hub edge marked `incomplete` and blocked from review queue
- [ ] Provenance metadata includes: generation_spec_id, context_sources, critique_score, qa_score, cost
- [ ] neo4j_synced_at and neo4j_sync_status columns updated on assessment_items row
- [ ] All Neo4j writes via neo4jQuery (Rule 1)
- [ ] Batch items with Promise.allSettled (Rule 3)

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 1 (C05) | neo4jQuery for all 9 edge creation queries |
| Rule 3 | Promise.allSettled for batch Supabase + Neo4j writes |
| Rule 6 (G08) | Supabase FIRST, Neo4j SECOND, Neo4j failure never blocks |
| Rule 10 (D03) | AssessmentItem uses SOURCED_FROM (not GROUNDED_IN) for provenance |
| D06 | Three-hub invariant: validate SubConcept + SLO + USMLE_Subtopic edges before `ready_for_review` |

);

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// apps/inngest/functions/p3-steps/provenance-write.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client';
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server';

export async function provenanceWrite(
  items: CompleteItem[],
  specId: string,
  institutionId: string
): Promise<WriteResult> {
  const supabase = createServerClient();

  // RULE 6: Supabase FIRST
  const { data: savedItems, error } = await supabase
    .from('assessment_items')
    .insert(items.map(item => ({
      generation_spec_id: specId,
      institution_id: institutionId,
      stem: item.stem,
      lead_in: item.leadIn,
      key_answer: item.key,
      distractors: item.distractors,
      rationale: item.rationale,
      bloom_level: item.bloomLevel,
      difficulty_band: item.difficultyBand,
      critique_score: item.critiqueScore,
      qa_score: item.qaScore,
      status: 'pending_review',
      provenance: item.provenance,
      neo4j_sync_status: 'pending',
    })))
    .select();

  if (error) throw new Error(`Supabase write failed: ${error.message}`);

  // RULE 6: Neo4j SECOND (failure never blocks)
  const neo4jResults = await Promise.allSettled(
    savedItems.map(item => writeNeo4jEdges(item, institutionId))
  );

  // Update sync status
  for (let i = 0; i < savedItems.length; i++) {
    const syncStatus = neo4jResults[i].status === 'fulfilled' ? 'synced' : 'failed';
    await supabase
      .from('assessment_items')
      .update({ neo4j_sync_status: syncStatus, neo4j_synced_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', savedItems[i].id);
  }

  return { saved: savedItems.length, synced: neo4jResults.filter(r => r.status === 'fulfilled').length };
}

async function writeNeo4jEdges(item: SavedItem, institutionId: string) {
  // Create all 9 edges in a single Cypher transaction
  await neo4jQuery(`
    MATCH (ai:AssessmentItem { uuid: $itemId })
    MATCH (sc:SubConcept { uuid: $subconceptId })
    MATCH (slo:SLO { uuid: $sloId })
    MATCH (ut:USMLE_Subtopic { uuid: $usmleSubtopicId })
    CREATE (ai)-[:TESTS]->(sc)
    CREATE (ai)-[:ALIGNED_TO]->(slo)
    CREATE (ai)-[:MAPS_TO]->(ut)
    // ... remaining edges
  `, { itemId: item.id, /* ... */ });
}
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DELETE FROM assessment_items WHERE generation_spec_id = '[spec_id]';`
2. Neo4j: `MATCH (ai:AssessmentItem { generation_spec_id: $specId }) DETACH DELETE ai`
3. git stash && git checkout develop
